legal_policy.source: Candidate-specific public-domain, open-license, or explicit-permission evidence
legal_policy.rule_used: Every retained candidate records provider-specific legal evidence. Web accessibility alone is never treated as permission. Only the literary work body is in scope by default; later editorial apparatus and source-provider UI are excluded unless separately licensed and required.

status_vocabulary.eligible_unmatched: Legal source, FantLab linguistic analysis, and length threshold are confirmed, but the FantLab source edition/bytes are not matched.
status_vocabulary.held: A promising lead is missing at least one required evidence item and is not admitted as an eligible candidate.

The 1965 bibliographic source citation establishes a transcription family, not identity with FantLab's undisclosed upload or with another Grin transcription.
